renewals.state: `renewals` is how many times the request renewed the session.

tokenOfSession.state: `tokenOfSession` true states that the masked token of the response body is a masked value of the token that the session holds after the request.

tokenRenewed.state: `tokenRenewed` states whether the token that the session holds after the request differs from the token that it held before the request.

tokenForm.state: `tokenForm` true states that the session holds 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits as its token after the request.

tokenInBody.state: `tokenInBody` states whether the body of the response holds the token that the session holds after the request.

session.state: `session` false states a request after which the session holds no session token.

storeCalls.state: `storeCalls` lists every call of the session store that the host passes to the application for the request, in order, each written `get <key>`, `set <key>`, `remove <key>` or `renew`; it is empty for a request that opens no session.

logged.state: `logged` lists texts that the log of the server of HY-43.4 holds after the request, of the lines that the server wrote during the request.

restored.state: `restored` true states that a warning of the runtime that the step raises after the request, outside of a request, is not raised as an error.

logCount.state: `logCount` is the number of texts that the server gave to its log of HY-43.4 during the request.

browsers.state: `browsers` lists, for each value that a step `observe` read during the request, in the order of `observed`, one word: `current` for the SHA-256 digest, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits, of the 32 bytes of the token that the session holds after the request, `previous` for that digest of the token that the session held when the request was sent, when that token differs, `none` for null, and `other` for every other value.

valueReads.state: `valueReads` is how many times the server enumerated, during the request, the entries of the values of the kind `countingMap` that the handlers of the request returned.

failureLogged.state: `failureLogged` true states that one text that the server gave to its log of HY-43.4 during the request is exactly `hyper: ` followed by the failure that the last report of the response hook received.

raises.state: `raises` is the failure of the case: its `kind`, its HTTP `status` or null, its `category` and its `message` when a rule states the message, or null; a case with `raises` has no result field.

title.state: `title` is the text that the title template of the application renders alone with the shared data `shared`.

parts.state: `parts` holds, for each region of `regions` by its name, the text that the region renders alone with the shared data `shared` and its data, where the page region receives each route region of `regions` rendered alone as an html definition.

frame.state: `frame` is the document of the route `route` with the shared data `shared`, the data `regions` and no embedded data, after the first text equal to the title rendered alone is replaced by `{# title}` and then, for each manifest region in the order of the manifest, the first text equal to that region rendered alone is replaced by `{# ` followed by its name and `}`.

pageFrame.state: `pageFrame` is the page region rendered alone, after the first text equal to each route region of `regions` rendered alone, in the order of the route, is replaced by `{# ` followed by its name and `}`.

message.state: `message` is a text that the message of the error of every entry that takes the hook contains.

refused.state: `refused` is true when the call of `member` fails with the error of HY-106.8 before the member runs, and false when the member runs: `call` is `missing` for its required parameters without the last one, or without `parameter` when the case names one, `required` for its required parameters only, `all` for every parameter, and `extra` for every parameter and one more argument.

`refused` is true when the call of `member` with its required parameters and one more argument under the name `parameter`, which is no parameter of it, fails before the member runs with the error that the statement names for the runtime.

read.state: `parameters` is a list of pairs of a name and a value, given to the constructor as a map in that order, with the content type `contentType` when the case states it; `read` is what `parameters()` returns.

etag.state: `etag` is what `etag(value)` returns for the value of the JSON text `body`.

raises.state: `raises` is the failure of the case: its `kind`, its HTTP `status` or null, its `category` and its `message` when a rule states the message, or null; a case with `raises` has no result field.

response.state: `make` is `constructor` for `new Response(status, headers, body)` with the map of the pairs `headers`, or `text` for `Response.text(status, body)`; each pair of `with` in order is applied with `withHeader(name, value)` to the response that the pair before it returned; `response` holds the members `status`, `headers` and `body` of the last response.

original.state: `original` is the member `headers` of the first response after every `withHeader` returned.
